title: badbunnyfan.site: the album art tiled as wallpaper behind a glass card
note: A fan site for Un Verano Sin Ti: the album artwork (hearts, palm trees, dolphins, suns) tiled edge to edge as the wallpaper, and one big pink-white glass card with rounded corners floating over it. Inside, favourite lyrics in a pixel-ish typewriter face, each with the song name under it in small spaced type, one line set in a brush script for contrast; a cropped photo of his eyes in a little browser window. Worth reusing: the subject itself, repeated small, is the background, so the page is the theme of its content. Wash it so type still reads. Built into the tiled-wallpaper block.
